reviews.comment: She was actually the best professor I've ever had. If you have the chance to take one of her classes do it!!! She cares so much about her students and is so willing to help you.

I really liked her teaching style, which worked best for me. We did have six exams, but they covered a chapter or two instead of just having a midterm and final. Expectations on how to succeed were clear from the very beginning, and she was accessible outside of class for any questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Shafron is a great professor who genuinely cares for her students - she's one of the nicest professors I've had at A&M. I will say that the class material is a bit boring with bi-weekly exams but expectations are clear and she makes sure her students succeed. Do the homework and extra practice and you'll be fine!

Emily's the best professor, genuinely cares about students, 6 exams covers small chapters (1-2 per exam), music video project & optional final exam, Hw/problem sets directly from the textbook, mirroring the exact exam content,option to attend via Zoom/ listen to her recorded lectures -Emily is incredibly supportive and truly deserves recognition

Emily is my girl, i genuinely think she is the best professor i have EVER had! I think she teaches well, yes there are 6 tests but accounting is hard and this makes the information manageable and good for my learning style. I went to her office hours in the beginning of the year and she was so helpful! I wish I could give her the world!
Nicest professor I've ever had, lets you know exactly what will be on exams

Emily is the nicest professor I have had at A&M. She wants students to do well and makes sure everyone is aware of what will be on exams. She is very very fair. Exams are given for each chapter, seven in total, and hw due every other day. It is easy to get behind, but you def have room to get a bad test grade or two.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a great professor.. just her order of teaching is completely off. She expects you to read the textbook and do the problem set which is due before the class where she teaches you that material. I find that completely counterproductive because teaching yourself accounting is not fun :))

ACCT 328 with Shafron was easily the most shambly and unorganized class I have taken at Mays. Her lectures were constantly wrong and she would have to correct them, she never knew what she was talking about, and her exams were extremely hard to the point where there had to be a massive curve put in place so people could pass. Don't take her.
